Sophisticated Architecture

Sleek Lines, Expansive Glass, Quiet Confidence

Bonito’s facade is a study in restraint — curved corners, layered balconies, and floor-to-ceiling glazing that turns the Dubai skyline into part of the architecture itself.

Arrival Lobby & Reception

A Grand Arrival, Every Time

Double-height ceilings, statement chandeliers, and warm marble set the tone the moment you step through the door — a lobby designed to feel less like a lobby and more like the beginning of home.

Rooftop Retreat

An Infinity Edge Above the Skyline

The rooftop pool holds the city at arm’s length — shimmering water, private cabanas, and uninterrupted views over Downtown Dubai from fourteen storeys up.

Signature Amenities

Leisure, Redefined

Outdoor Cinema

Plush recliners and ambient lighting for evening screenings under the sky, with a poolside refreshment bar close at hand.

Premium Concierge

A dedicated resident support team for appointments, deliveries, and local recommendations, on call whenever you need them.

Little Explorers’ Zone

A vibrant, shaded play area with soft flooring and a splash zone, so the youngest residents have a place of their own.

Sauna & Steam

Heat therapy suites built for quiet recovery — a calming escape from the day within the comfort of the building.

Recreational Zone

Wall climbing, table tennis, billiards, mini golf, and a skating area — something for every age, every evening.

Business Center

A fully-equipped work environment with high-speed internet and meeting rooms, for residents who work as much as they unwind.

Interiors Residences

Designed to Unwind

Every residence carries the same considered hand — tactile finishes, warm lighting, and a headboard wall that frames the skyline instead of competing with it. Comfort and style, in equal measure.
